chart.description: Invocation latency per model mean, max and min over time
chart.name: Top 10 invocation latency overview by model
chart.programText:
A = data('InvocationLatency', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/Bedrock') and filter('stat', 'mean'), rollup='average', extrapolation='zero').dimensions(renames={"Model id": "ModelId"}).mean(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).mean(by=['Model id']).top(10).publish(label='A')
B = data('InvocationLatency', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/Bedrock') and filter('stat', 'upper'), rollup='max', extrapolation='zero').dimensions(renames={"Model id": "ModelId"}).max(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).max(by=['Model id']).top(10).publish(label='B')
C = data('InvocationLatency', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/Bedrock') and filter('stat', 'lower'), rollup='min', extrapolation='zero').dimensions(renames={"Model id": "ModelId"}).min(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).min(by=['Model id']).top(10).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Top 10 aws service call errors count
chart.programText:
A = data('sf.org.num.awsServiceAuthErrorCount', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/Bedrock'), extrapolation='zero').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum().top(count=10).publish(label='A')
B = data('sf.org.num.awsServiceCallThrottles', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/Bedrock'), extrapolation='zero').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum().top(count=10).publish(label='B')
C = data('sf.org.num.awsServiceCallThrottledRetryFailures', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/Bedrock'), extrapolation='zero').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum().top(count=10).publish(label='C')
D = data('sf.org.num.awsServiceCallCountExceptions', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/Bedrock'), extrapolation='zero').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum().top(count=10).publish(label='D')

chart.name: Token usage trend
chart.programText:
A = data('InputTokenCount', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/Bedrock'), rollup='sum').sum(by=['aws_account_id']).publish(label='A')
B = data('OutputTokenCount', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/Bedrock'), rollup='sum').sum(by=['aws_account_id']).publish(label='B')
C = (A+B).sum(by=['aws_account_id']).publish(label='C')
